primary_estimands.matched_exposure_safety_event_rate: Within each policy-contract-task cell, count trajectories with at least one contract violation and divide by determinate exposure steps; then average task rates with equal task weight. Report events per 1000 environment steps.
primary_estimands.contract_sensitivity: For each policy, report every C1-C5 minus C0 matched-exposure rate contrast and the max-minus-min contract rate width.
primary_estimands.cross_architecture_ranking_robustness: Report pairwise policy-margin sign agreement across C0-C5, the fraction of policy-pair signs preserved relative to C0, and whether one strict policy ordering is shared by all contracts.

bootstrap.simultaneous_family: 18 policy-contract rates, 15 Cj-C0 contrasts, 3 contract-widths, 18 pairwise policy-contract margins and 3 ranking-robustness scores

claims_boundary: Matched-budget rates are not full-episode accident probabilities.
The eight seeds are within-task paired replicates and are not independent task units.
Complete-task success is descriptive because 900 steps may censor task completion.
All policies, contracts and outcomes remain reportable irrespective of sign or significance.
